TextMSID:
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0010  (The number 16 brings to mind
Dragonite! It can fly in spite of its big
and bulky physique. It circles the globe
in just 16 hours.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0020  (You’ve collected 25 cards. 25 is
Pikachu’s National Pokédex
number! When several Pikachu
gather, their electricity can build
and cause lightning storms.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0030  (You’ve collected 50 cards. 50 is
Diglett’s National Pokédex number!
It lives about one yard underground,
where it feeds on plant roots. It
sometimes appears aboveground.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0040  (The number 80 brings to mind
Tentacruel! Its 80 tentacles can
stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel
ensnares prey in a net of spread-out
tentacles, delivering venomous stings
to its catch.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0050  (The number 100 brings to mind
Machop! Its whole body is composed
of muscles. Even though it’s the size
of a human child, it can hurl 100
grown-ups.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0060  (The number 151 brings to mind the
Pokédex! A total of 151 Pokémon
were introduced in Pokémon Red
and Pokémon Blue.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0070  (The number 180 brings to mind
Noctowl! When it needs to think, it
rotates its head 180 degrees to
sharpen its intellectual power.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0080  (You’ve collected 250 cards. 250 is
Ho-Oh’s National Pokédex
number! It will reveal itself before
a pure-hearted Trainer by shining
its bright, rainbow-colored wings.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0090  (The number 300 brings to mind
Florges! It is said that there was once
a Florges that protected the garden of
a castle for over 300 years.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0100  (The number 500 brings to mind
Spiritomb! It was bound to a fissure in
an odd keystone as punishment for
misdeeds 500 years ago.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0110  (You’ve collected 777 cards. 777 is
Togedemaru’s National Pokédex
number! When it’s in trouble, it
curls up into a ball, makes its fur
spikes stand on end, and then
discharges electricity indiscriminately.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0120  (The number 1,000 brings to mind
Jirachi! It is said to have the ability to
grant any wish for just one week
every thousand years.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0130  (The number 1,500 brings to mind
Gimmighoul! This Pokémon was born
inside a treasure chest about 1,500
years ago. It sucks the life-force out of
scoundrels who try to steal the
treasure.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0140  (The number 2,000 brings to mind
Conkeldurr! It is thought that
Conkeldurr taught humans how to
make concrete more than 2,000
years ago.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0150  (The number 5,000 brings to mind
Alakazam! It is said to have an IQ of
approximately 5,000. Its overflowing
psychokinetic powers cause headaches
to anyone nearby.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0160  (The number 10,000 brings to mind
Wartortle! It is said to live 10,000
years. Its furry tail is popular as a
symbol of longevity.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0170  (The number 15,000 brings to mind
Toxtricity! The jolts of electricity it
launches by violently strumming the
protrusions on its chest easily exceed
15,000 volts.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0180  (The number 20,000 brings to mind
Claydol! This mysterious Pokémon
started life as an ancient clay figurine
made over 20,000 years ago.)

CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0190  (The number 100,000 brings to mind
Raichu! It can loose 100,000-volt
bursts of electricity, instantly downing
foes several times its size.)
